text:
ellie-marketing: Kickoff: want a micro-benchmark + landing + webinar combo. Lean deck: 5 slides, clear ROI slide, and 3 test headlines. Goal is to convince PMs and infra engineers. Thoughts? :rocket:

noah-analytics: Chart suggestions: 1) cost-per-1k tokens by seq len (overlay hosted/dedicated/private), 2) p50/p95/p99 latency bars, 3) simple ROI calc (monthly tokens -> monthly savings) with assumptions footnote. Also add a mini-case: 100k msgs/day chat workload.

tia-growth: For headlines (short): a) "Lower inference spend, keep response times tight" b) "Predictable p99 under load" c) "Routing that protects SLAs and margins" — will A/B test.

sam-design: Visuals: use three small panels: cost, latency curve, routing map. Use color palette consistent with launch kit. I'll mock variants. Need data to mock.

noah-analytics: Quick numbers for mocks (conservative):
```
seqs = [32, 128, 512]
latency_hosted_ms = [12, 34, 140]
latency_dedicated_ms = [8, 20, 90]
cost_hosted_per_1k = [0.0035, 0.010, 0.06]
cost_dedicated_per_1k = [0.0025, 0.007, 0.035]
cache_hit = 0.45 # 45% KV prefix hit
```
Use a CDF overlay for tail latency slide and a stacked bar for token-cost split (GPU time + infra premium + licensing).

tia-growth: Landing form microcopy: "Enter tokens/day, latency target, and compliance needs" -> Map to: self-serve (hosted), reserved (dedicated), managed (private). Add an optional checkbox: "Want pricing estimate" which triggers an email with ranges.

ellie-marketing: Microclaims for slide 1 (vote): 1) "Cut inference costs while meeting SLAs" 2) "Keep p99 latency within target during spikes" 3) "Seamless failover across model variants" — react with :+1: / :-1:.

sam-design: +1 +1 +1 on all. Also propose a tiny decision tree visual: if latency <50ms -> hosted; if latency 50-200 ms and compliance false -> dedicated; if compliance true -> private.

noah-analytics: I'll prepare a short ROI example: assume 200M tokens/mo, show 3 scenarios (hosted baseline, dedicated, dedicated+cache/batching). Footnote assumptions: model family, token mix, batch sizes, cache hit.

ops-bot: Heads-up: design review scheduled in 36h, full deck due in 24h. :alarm_clock:

ellie-marketing: Next steps: (1) Noah -> final numbers + ROI table by EOD, (2) Sam -> design mocks + color variants by 12pm tomorrow, (3) Tia -> 6 social post drafts + landing copy by EOD. I'll assemble and run a 10m review before dry-run. Drop objections/edge cases here (model parity, security, rollout risk).
